summary: Robot policies trained by imitation generalize poorly outside the environments and objects seen in training. Published data-scaling studies find that generalization grows with the diversity of training environments and objects rather than with more demonstrations per environment.
takeaways: Later versions of this paper will add benchmarks and cover further releases toward 100,000 hours.
This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera.
Published data-scaling studies find that generalization grows with the diversity of training environments and objects rather than with more demonstrations per environment.
